'''Cellheim Anujo''' served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Tundra Dowmeia]] of the [[Galactic Senate]] toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], Anujo and Dowmeia were part of a group that greeted [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] on the landing platform of the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] after the [[chancellor]] was rescued during the [[Battle of Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Cellheim Anujo was an [[aide]] to [[Quarren]] [[Senator]] [[Tundra Dowmeia]],<ref name="VE" /> who was one of the representatives of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. Dowmeia was a member of the [[Delegation of 2,000]], which meant the Quarren needed the aide to be loyal, willing to keep many secrets, and ready to protect the senator during such dark and dangerous [[time]]s.<ref name="VE" />

[[File:PalpatineWelcomingCommittee-ROTS.png|thumb|left|300px|Cellheim Anujo (center) was among the crowd who waited for the return of the rescued Sheev Palpatine after the Battle of Coruscant.]]
After the [[Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Anujo and Dowmeia were part of a group that gathered on the landing platform of the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] on<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Coruscant]] in order to greet [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who had been rescued from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] during the battle by the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The reception moved forward as Palpatine disembarked from a [[Util-313]] [[speeder bus]] and then followed the [[chancellor]] into the Senate Building.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Equipment==
Anujo wore [[Color|black]] [[robe]]s and a [[Clothing|veil]] while on the platform.<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Strongest memory has to be after we did the first take George Lucas was talking to his First Assistant Director about the set-up, he then left and George came over to me. He told me what we were going to do for the next set up and that the shot would be starting on me! That's quite a feeling when you've grown up playing with the little action figures then you've got the Director of this telling you they're going to start the shot on you!|Dean Mitchell|<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith/dean-mitchell-cellheim-anujo|text=Dean Mitchel (Cellheim Anujo)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2010-05|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20221209055817|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:AnujoUnmasked-Featurette.png|thumb|right|300px|Cellheim Anujo was portrayed by both T.V. Moore and Dean Mitchell.]]
Cellheim Anujo appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[T.V. Moore]] portrayed the character<ref name="Snapshot">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/10/sithsnap20051010.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Sith Snapshots: Loyal Delegates}}</ref> during filming in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]], where the landing platform scene was filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> [[Dean Mitchell]] then portrayed the character in scenes later shot at [[Shepperton Studios]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. For the second take, director [[George Lucas]] informed Mitchell that the shot would be starting focused on Anujo, but that take was not used in the final version of the film. The shear weight of the fabrics in the Anujo costume caused Mitchell to get very hot while filming, but due to the size of Anujo's cloth headpiece, Mitchell was able to take it off between takes to cool down.<ref name="Interview" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Cellheim Anujo was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', which was written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> and published on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/mxQvt|archivedate=2022-04-24}}</ref>
